newsitem.title: USA: WMS debt conversion price lowered.
newsitem.headline: WMS debt conversion price lowered.

text.p: WMS Industries Inc said Thursday the conversion price of the $57.5 million of 5-3/4 percent convertible subordinated debt due 2002 would be adjusted to $23.03 a share from $29 a share for debt converted on or after April 1.
This is subject to the completion of the company's previously announced spin-off of WHG Resorts & Casinos Inc, the subsidiary that owns WMS' Puerto Rico hotel and casino businesses.
The conversion price adjustment is based upon a formula in the indenture covering the debt, the gaming equipment company said.

After the adjustment, the debt will be convertible into about 2.5 million shares of WMS common stock. The holders of debt who convert on or after April 1 will not receive shares of WHG, the company said.
